definitions.explanation: A blood vessel that carries oxygenated blood away from the heart to the body.

examples.japanese: {動脈|どうみゃく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{血液|けつえき}→血液：02703_ketsueki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: Arteries carry blood from the heart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動脈|どうみゃく}{硬化|こうか}→動脈硬化：24512_doumyakukouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧な⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{頸動脈|けいどうみゃく}→頸動脈：29064_keidoumyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{脈|みゃく}→脈：05247_myaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: I measure the pulse at the carotid artery.

notes:
{動脈|どうみゃく} refers to arteries—blood vessels that carry oxygenated blood away from the heart to the body.

TYPES OF ARTERIES:
- ⟦{大動脈|だいどうみゃく}→大動脈：12375_daidoumyaku⟧: aorta (main artery)
- ⟦{冠動脈|かんどうみゃく}→冠動脈：29065_kandoumyaku⟧: coronary artery (heart)
- ⟦{頸動脈|けいどうみゃく}→頸動脈：29064_keidoumyaku⟧: carotid artery (neck)
- ⟦{肺動脈|はいどうみゃく}→肺動脈：noentry⟧: pulmonary artery

RELATED MEDICAL TERMS:
- ⟦{動脈硬化|どうみゃくこうか}→動脈硬化：24512_doumyakukouka⟧: arteriosclerosis (hardening of arteries)
- ⟦{動脈瘤|どうみゃくりゅう}→動脈瘤：noentry⟧: aneurysm
- ⟦{動脈血|どうみゃくけつ}→動脈血：noentry⟧: arterial blood

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {動脈|どうみゃく}: artery (carries blood FROM the heart)
- ⟦{静脈|じょうみゃく}→静脈：05858_joumyaku⟧: vein (carries blood TO the heart)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{脈|みゃく}→脈：05247_myaku⟧: pulse
- ⟦{血管|けっかん}→血管：02742_kekkan⟧: blood vessel
